items.informal_name: Combinatorial Nullstellensatz: Existence of Non-Vanishing Evaluation
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {σ : Type u_2} [Finite σ] [IsDomain R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (t : σ →₀ ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.coeff t f ≠ 0 →
    f.totalDegree = Finsupp.degree t →
      ∀ (S : σ → Finset R), (∀ (i : σ), t i < (S i).card) → ∃ s, (∀ (i : σ), s i ∈ S i) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval s) f ≠ 0
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be an integral domain, $ f $ a multivariate polynomial in $ R[\sigma] $, and $ t $ a monomial with nonzero coefficient in $ f $ such that the total degree of $ f $ equals the degree of $ t $. For any family of finite subsets $ S_i \subseteq R $ indexed by $ \sigma $, if each $ S_i $ has cardinality strictly greater than the exponent of $ t $ in variable $ i $, then there exists an evaluation $ s : \sigma \to R $ with $ s(i) \in S_i $ for all $ i $, such that $ f(s) \neq 0 $. This is the combinatorial Nullstellensatz existence theorem.

items.informal_name: Zero Evaluation of Ascending Pochhammer Polynomial iff Argument is Negative Integer Below n
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] [IsDomain R] (n : ℕ) (r : R),
  Polynomial.eval r (ascPochhammer R n) = 0 ↔ ∃ k < n, ↑k = -r
items.informal_description: For a polynomial ring over an integral domain $ R $, the ascending Pochhammer polynomial $ \text{ascPochhammer}_n(X) = X(X+1)\cdots(X+n-1) $ evaluated at $ r \in R $ equals zero if and only if there exists an integer $ k < n $ such that $ r = -k $. This equivalence relies on $ R $ having no zero divisors, ensuring the product vanishes only when one of its linear factors $ r + k $ is zero.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order of a Monomial Equals Its Weight for Non-zero Coefficients
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = if a = 0 then ⊤ else ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of the monomial with coefficient $ a $ and exponent $ d $ is equal to the weight $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) $ if $ a \neq 0 $, and $ \infty $ otherwise.

items.informal_name: Weighted Order Equals n iff Existence of Minimal Non-Zero Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔
    (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0
items.informal_description: For a multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ and a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $, the weighted order of $ f $ is equal to $ n $ if and only if there exists a monomial $ d $ with non-zero coefficient in $ f $ such that the weighted sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} w(i) \cdot d(i) = n $, and every monomial with weighted sum less than $ n $ has zero coefficient in $ f $.

items.informal_name: Non-zero iff Weighted Order is Finite
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  f ≠ 0 ↔ ↑(MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f).toNat = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f
items.informal_description: A multivariate power series $ f $ over a semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $ is non-zero if and only if its weighted order with respect to a weight function $ w : \sigma \to \mathbb{N} $ is a finite natural number (i.e., $ f \neq 0 $ if and only if $ \operatorname{weightedOrder}(f, w) \in \mathbb{N} $).

items.informal_name: Infimum of Finite Set Equals Bottom Element iff an Element is Bottom
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_5} {α : Type u_7} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : BoundedOrder α] [Nontrivial α] {s : Finset ι}
  {f : ι → α}, s.inf f = ⊥ ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b = ⊥
items.informal_description: For a non-trivial linearly ordered set $\alpha$ with a bounded order, the infimum of a function $f : \iota \to \alpha$ over a finite set $s$ equals the bottom element $\bot$ if and only if there exists an element $b \in s$ such that $f(b) = \bot$.

items.informal_name: Infimum over Finite Set Equals Bottom iff an Element Maps to Bottom
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_5} {α : Type u_7} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : BoundedOrder α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α},
  s.Nonempty → (s.inf f = ⊥ ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b = ⊥)
items.informal_description: For a non-empty finite set $ s $ and a function $ f : \iota \to \alpha $ where $ \alpha $ is a linearly ordered set with a bounded order, the infimum $ \bigwedge_{b \in s} f(b) $ equals the least element $ \bot $ if and only if there exists an element $ b \in s $ such that $ f(b) = \bot $.

items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Infimum of Extended Natural Numbers Equals Zero iff Zero is Present
items.type: ∀ {ι : Sort u_1} {f : ι → ℕ∞}, ⨅ i, f i = 0 ↔ ∃ i, f i = 0
items.informal_description: For any family $ f $ of extended natural numbers $ \mathbb{N}^\top $, the infimum $ \inf_{i} f(i) $ is equal to zero if and only if there exists an index $ i $ such that $ f(i) = 0 $.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree Invariance under WithTop Embedding
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]
  {D : A → T} {s : AddMonoidAlgebra R A},
  s.support.Nonempty → AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (WithTop.some ∘ D) s = ↑(AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D s)
items.informal_description: For a non-empty finite support element $ s $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, the infimum degree computed using the degree function $ D $ composed with the $ \text{WithTop} $ embedding equals the infimum degree computed directly with $ D $. Formally, $ \infdegree (\top \circ D) s = \infdegree D s $, where $ \top $ denotes the canonical embedding of $ A $ into $ \text{WithTop}(A) $.

items.informal_name: Supremum Degree of Basis Elements in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} (a : A) (r : R), AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (AddMonoidAlgebra.single a r) = if r = 0 then ⊥ else D a
items.informal_description: For any element $a$ in an additive monoid $A$ and scalar $r$ in a semiring $R$, the supremum degree of the basis element $\text{single}\, a\, r$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$ is equal to $D(a)$ if $r \neq 0$, and the bottom element $\bot$ otherwise. Here, $D$ denotes the given degree function on $A$.
